tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every step. Warm off-white, the only ground.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces on paper: scene cards, coach bubble, composer, modal.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed wells: empty drop zones, disabled fields.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Legacy neutral selected fill. Prefer action-bg for anything the user picked.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders and dividers. Lumi prefers borders over shadows.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill. 13:1 on paper.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, inactive nav. 4.6:1 on paper; keep at 12px or larger.

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Lumi blue. Focus rings, audit bars, the brand accent. Not for body text (3:1).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Action fill (action-bg): selected choices, chips, segments, active nav, current row, open accordion.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Text of a supported / answered chip. 4.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: ok-line
tokens.usage: Border of a supported / answered chip.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Text of a stated-only chip (claim with no proof yet).

tokens.name: warn-line
tokens.usage: Border of a stated chip.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Text links, current-row bar and number, “待确认” mark, filled score bars.

tokens.name: info-line
tokens.usage: Border of an inferred chip.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: “缺材料” mark, warning banners, empty score bars’ first segment. State only.

tokens.name: danger-line
tokens.usage: Border of a missing chip.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Sun in the 纯图片 slide thumbnail only. Not for UI.

tokens.name: action-bg
tokens.usage: Selected / current fill. Alias of soft.

tokens.name: action-line
tokens.usage: 1px border of a selected control. Alias of blue.

tokens.name: action-ink
tokens.usage: Check mark, current-row bar and number. Alias of info.

styles.name: section

styles.name: body

styles.usage: Default text, inputs, buttons, coach copy.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, section labels, secondary buttons, breadcrumb.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Chips, nav phase labels, meta lines, timing.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Scene and FAQ numbers stay serif only in slide thumbnails; list rows use the sans at 14/500, muted.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: The 故事评分 number only.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text inside chips; between stacked coach paragraphs.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, buttons in a row, choice cards.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of controls and coach bubble (vertical).

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Card inner gap, horizontal padding of controls, mobile gutter.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between sections inside a step.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page heading and content; content top padding.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Large separation between independent blocks.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Wide-screen gutter.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Shared left/right edge for topbar, content and composer (64 at 1600px+, 32 at 1100px-, 16 at 720px-).

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: Sidebar width.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Height of inputs, selects and nav rows.

tokens.name: composer-h
tokens.usage: Height of the bottom composer and the step CTA beside it.

tokens.name: r-chip
tokens.usage: Status chips and counts.

tokens.name: r-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, choice cards, the language toggle, icon buttons, toasts.

tokens.name: r-surface
tokens.usage: Scene cards, composer, modal, preview shell.

tokens.name: r-tag
tokens.usage: Multi-select tags. Softer than a card, squarer than a pill.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Round markers only (numbered dots). Not for chips or toggles.
